description: This file defines models and a fetcher for TMX Insider Trading data, including query parameters, data structures, and data retrieval and transformation logic.

classes.name: TmxInsiderTradingQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for TMX insider trading data, including a summary flag.

classes.name: TmxInsiderTradingData
classes.description: Represents individual insider trading data with fields like period, owner, trade details, and net activity.

classes.name: TmxInsiderTradingFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and transforming TMX insider trading data asynchronously.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a TmxInsiderTradingQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw insider trading data from TMX GraphQL endpoint.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into structured TmxInsiderTradingData instances, either detailed or summarized based on query.
